# Pre-Implementation Requirements-Quality Checklist: Silver and Gold Layers with M1/M2 Baselines

**Purpose**: Test whether the requirements of 002 are complete, clear, consistent, measurable and covered before implementation. It checks the writing of the requirements, not the code.
**Created**: 2026-11-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [tasks.md](../tasks.md) | [analysis.md](../analysis.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Focus**: (1) data integrity and determinism of silver/gold; (2) gate decisions and cut-list consistency across artifacts.
**Depth**: Standard (pre-implementation gate) | **Audience**: Reviewer (PR), data owner.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the behaviour of a cycle with no new bus report (same `as_of_ts` and `max_bronze_id` in `data` clock mode) defined against "one snapshot per cycle"? [Gap, Spec §FR-016, §FR-036, Research R5]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the retention rule ("snapshots kept, no deletion") stated as a requirement that can be checked? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for an Estimated bus that is also the leader (label kept) and for a broken-down bus that is also Estimated? [Gap, Spec Assumptions, §FR-011, §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for a bus that returns after the 120 s rule while an incident is active? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the headway clamp to 0 (negative difference) written in the spec or only in research? [Gap, Spec §FR-020, Research R8]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for the idle `data` clock when all buses stop reporting (clock stops, no Estimated state live)? [Coverage, Research R3]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "local time" defined once, with the same rule (fixed UTC−5 offset) in spec, research, data-model and tasks? [Conflict, Spec §FR-026, Research R7, Data-model S5, Task T032]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the boundary example in T051 (date change) stated with the correct UTC instant for local midnight? [Ambiguity, Task T051, T027, T076]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "operational bus" defined precisely enough to decide whether an Estimated bus is operational for headway and service metric? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, §FR-024, Research R8]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "the bus directly behind" defined when the bus ahead of an Estimated bus is itself broken down and skipped? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011, §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "first clock-aligned window at or after `as_of_ts`" unambiguous when `as_of_ts` falls exactly on a boundary? [Clarity, Spec §FR-032, Task T051]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "about every 5 s" in the US4 scenario bounded by the SC-009 tolerance (5 s ± 1 s, 95 %)? [Clarity, Spec US4-1, §SC-009]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Do spec SC-002 (4 fixtures), plan phase table, quickstart and T038 (5 scenarios) state the same fixture set after T075? [Conflict, Spec §SC-002, Plan §Phases, Quickstart Phase 2, Task T038]
- [ ] CHK014 Do plan "What is cut", tasks "Cut List" and quickstart agree on what is cuttable in Phase 4? [Conflict, Plan §What is cut, Tasks §Cut List, Quickstart Phase 4]
- [ ] CHK015 Do plan and tasks agree on which phases are not cuttable (0–2 versus 0–3)? [Conflict, Plan §What is cut, Tasks §Cut List]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the minimum delivery stated once and consistently (Phases 0–3 plus the loop tasks)? [Ambiguity, Tasks §Cut List, §Implementation Strategy]
- [ ] CHK017 Do FR-004 (live reference time is current UTC) and R3 (`data` default for the demo) read as one rule for a reviewer? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Research R3]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the five gate adjustments of tasks (T075, T076, narrowed CUT-1, fixed UTC−5 offset, compose wiring of the planned headway) reflected in plan, research, quickstart and contracts docs? [Consistency, Tasks §Cut List, T002, T032, T075, T076]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the planned headway (600) given one source of truth, with the test that links simulator and `config.corridor_settings` stated in spec or plan? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, Research R14, Task T016]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK020 Can SC-009 (cadence, readable-before-notify) be objectively verified if the 10-minute run is cut? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009, Tasks §CUT-1]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the loop-level "next cycle runs normally after a failure" backed by an acceptance criterion that survives CUT-1? [Coverage, Spec US4-3, §FR-040, Task T064, T066]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the x.5 rounding decision (half away from zero) backed by an acceptance criterion that survives CUT-3? [Coverage, Research R13, Task T053, T054]
- [ ] CHK023 Is SC-006 "within 0.1 s" for M1 reference values tied to an independent oracle definition? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, Task T052]
- [ ] CHK024 Does SC-002 define "match the fixtures" so that headway values are excluded and the compared fields are listed? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002, Task T023]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements defined for equal-distance buses, exact thresholds (300 s, 900 s) and exactly 120 s? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Are recovery requirements defined for silver rebuild after a failed cycle and after an advisory-lock skip? [Coverage, Research R6, Spec §FR-040]
- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements for late-arriving events (event time much earlier than arrival time) testable beyond "event time is used"? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements defined for a dispatched reserve bus appearing in `corridor_now` and leaving `reserve_free`? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-033]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK029 Is a cycle-duration expectation stated (cycle must fit in 5 s) with a measurable limit, or only logged? [Gap, Plan §Performance Goals, Spec §FR-039]
- [ ] CHK030 Are log content requirements specified (fields, no PII, no stack traces) in one place for the refresh loop and `compute`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-040, Research R16]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the no-write-to-bronze requirement measurable for both code and tests (static guard scope, test builders using `ingest`)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002, Task T025]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK032 Is the dependency on unmerged 001 stated with a rule for what happens if 001 changes (R14 edits 001 code and tests)? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Research R14]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the M2 simplification (all direction-1 riders attributed to Prado) flagged for data-owner confirmation with an owner and date? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the dependency on `jsonschema`, `rfc3339-validator` and PyYAML in the dev extra recorded with the task that adds each? [Dependency, Research R9, Task T011, T002]
- [ ] CHK035 Are turn-1 deferred norms (Redis, PostGIS, 1,000 events/s, config version in lineage) recorded as evolution rather than requirements? [Assumption, Research R15, turns-ritmo §3.3]

## Ambiguities and Conflicts

- [ ] CHK036 Is a single statement present that tasks.md prevails over plan.md when their cut lists differ? [Conflict, Plan §What is cut, Tasks §Cut List]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the `c1_bunching` fixture value (752 → 960) approval recorded where the spec's "must be corrected by the data owner" assumption can be closed? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions, Task T075]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Items CHK001, CHK007, CHK008, CHK013–CHK016, CHK020–CHK022 correspond to findings in [analysis.md](../analysis.md) (M3, M2, H1, M1, H2, M7, M4, M5).
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`.
